response.text:
Starting the 15th, on‑call will move from one‑week to two‑week shifts to improve continuity and reduce handoffs. Your assigned two‑week blocks will be posted in the usual on‑call schedule. 

Please perform a clear handoff at the start and end of your block, covering incident status, ongoing tasks, and upcoming maintenance. If you can’t cover an assigned block, arrange a swap and notify the on‑call coordinator promptly. 

Questions or concerns — contact your manager or reply to this message. Thanks for your cooperation.
